title: spec(dashboard): the global filter `field` TSDoc says the analytics query API serves an undeclared object field as an ad-hoc dimension — false for dataset queries once PR #34198 lands
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUg7BKfRBcTPyMxbLh

Filing gate ③: area-directed (area S2 of seat domain:server#5). Finding M1 of the L2 contract review 6908009392 on PR #34198 (card #34005), the spec half, which is outside that PR's claimed surface.

## Today

`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` (the TSDoc on the dashboard global filter's `field`, around line 1615) says the analytics query API "does accept an object's own field as an ad-hoc dimension without the dataset declaring it". With PR #34198, a dataset query (REST single and batch doors, `query_dataset`, the MCP bridges, the publish build probes) refuses any measure or dimension the dataset does not declare, under the maintainer ruling 6902027136. The sentence then describes a capability the dataset path no longer has. The same sentence in `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` is corrected inside PR #34198.

## Ask

Rewrite the TSDoc sentence to match: the dataset door answers declared members only; name the cube door (`POST /analytics/query`) only if it is still true there. Run the spec's generated-artifact gates (build-docs reference page, schema baselines) for the TSDoc change. Text only; no schema shape changes.

Blocked-by: #34198 (land after it, so the text never runs ahead of the code).

Reader: domain:spec. Size XS.
